ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of Medicaid fraud on vulnerable populations, including low-income families and individuals with disabilities.
ideas.angle: The human impact of Medicaid fraud
questions: What are the consequences of Medicaid fraud for vulnerable populations?
How can the federal government and states work to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the human impact of Medicaid fraud and the need for greater oversight and accountability in the program.
